text: • To improve the effectiveness of PM USA's youth smoking
prevention efforts by developing information, analyses
and interpretation of the pre-teen and teenage population.
• To support YSP Communications group by qualitatively
and quantitatively testing each communication initiative
to ensure clear communication of a no smoking message.
• To support the YSP Program group by providing research
information that will aid in the development of programs
aimed at reducing the incidence of youth smoking.
